message.content: {"findings": [{"cwe": "CWE-22", "class": "Expand", "method": "extractFile", "explanation": "In `Expand.extractFile`, a tainted archive entry name from `ZipEntry.getName()` is passed through `FileUtils.resolveFile` and reaches `new FileOutputStream(f)`. The only protection is `if (!f.getAbsolutePath().startsWith(dir.getAbsolutePath()))`, which is inadequate because it compares non-normalized string prefixes; a value such as `../analysis-output2/evil` still starts with the destination path while escaping the intended directory."}]}
